description:
A native IPTV player for Windows. You bring your own M3U or Xtream Codes playlist.

Raudo is a native IPTV player for Windows 10 and 11. It is the player — you bring your own playlist (an M3U/M3U8 link or your Xtream Codes credentials). Raudo does not include, host or provide any channels, streams or media content.

Features: catch-up and EPG guide, speed control to reach the live edge, recording and picture-in-picture, parental control, favorites and folders. Free, no account, no ads, and it updates itself.
